national_parks_left_out_note: Mount Royal National Park and Werakata National Park were rejected (remote or only a picnic area and a bike loop; one source each). COVERAGE.md makes every national park a destination, so the owner should confirm the exclusion on the "What qualifies" ground (2: nothing a visitor travels for), not on placement.
marginal_kept_for_owner: Patonga to Pearl Beach Walking Track
benchmark: No NZ benchmark place lies in this region. Region-relevant checks: operators and vehicles rejected (Irukandji Shark & Ray Encounters, Sand Dune Safaris, Moonshadow-TQC Cruises, Imagine Cruises, Hot-air Ballooning, wine tour operators, Central Coast reef charters) in favour of the places (Stockton Beach, Port Stephens, Pokolbin); festivals and annual events rejected (Surfest, Mattara, This Is Not Art, Jazz in the Vines, A Day on the Green, Steamfest, Morpeth Jazz Festival and others); a cathedral, a library, a stadium and a sports park rejected as civic or venue buildings (Christ Church Cathedral, Newcastle Regional Library, Central Coast Stadium, Maitland Park); Miss Porter's House rejected as open one afternoon a month; Wondabyne (rail halt whose draw is the walk beyond it) rejected, not kept, as the gateway-journey case.
